title: Good Vibes Only | KEY.co
description_expanded: Experience the pinnacle of coastal luxury at this stunning Blue Mountain Beach retreat along the iconic 30A. A masterpiece of modern design, this home is tailor-made for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends. The heart of the home is a spectacular open-concept living area with soaring ceilings and an expansive wall of glass doors that seamlessly merge the indoors with the private outdoor oasis. The outdoor space is a haven of relaxation and entertainment, featuring a heated pool and spa, a cozy lounge area, a fireplace, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen. Inside, the chef’s kitchen is a culinary delight, offering top-tier appliances and ample space to create memorable meals. With four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, this home accommodates up to ten guests in comfort and style.

Features: No diving into the pool hot tub or spa;
No intoxicated persons may use the pool hot tub or spa;
No use of glass containers by the pool;
No one should use the pool hot tub or spa alone;
No alcoholic drinks are allowed in the pool area
Users must shower prior to using the pool
Use the pool safety equipment only in case of emergency.
Outdoor seating Patio Outdoor grill Heated pool Garden
